verdict: Fast and safe; the link preview and the legal pages are missing

headline.title: Booking form loses phone numbers
headline.text: The phone field opens a letter keyboard and has no label for screen readers

kpis.title: Tasks in the fix plan
kpis.note: Start with the red one: it costs bookings

blocks.name: Booking form
blocks.summary: Phone numbers come in with mistakes

items.text: The phone field opens a letter keyboard on phones
items.fix: Make the phone field a phone-number field so the digit keypad opens

items.text: The fields have no labels, only grey hints inside them
items.fix: Give every field a visible label above it

blocks.name: Link preview in messengers
blocks.summary: A shared link arrives without a picture or title

items.text: The page has no preview card for Telegram, WhatsApp and VK
items.fix: Add a 1200×630 picture and a title for link previews

blocks.name: Documents and law
blocks.summary: Classes are sold without terms or a privacy policy

items.text: No privacy policy next to the booking form
items.fix: Publish a privacy policy and link it under the form

items.text: No public terms with the refund rules
items.fix: Publish the class terms with a fair refund rule

blocks.name: Protection
blocks.summary: Nothing leaks, but standard protection is off

items.text: The server does not switch on browser security settings
items.fix: Turn on six standard security headers in the server config

items.text: The server tells everyone its version
items.fix: Hide the server version with one config line

items.text: An old draft page is still open at /old-index.html
items.fix: Delete the old draft page from the server

items.text: Project files, backups and settings are not reachable from outside
The same page opens at two addresses, with and without www
items.fix: Redirect the www address to the main one

items.text: Search robots are allowed in, the sitemap is valid

blocks.name: Usable by everyone
blocks.summary: Works from a phone and a keyboard

items.text: Footer links are smaller than a fingertip
items.fix: Make the footer links taller, at least 24 pixels

items.text: Zoom is allowed, the whole page works with the Tab key

blocks.name: How the server delivers files
blocks.summary: Compressed and cached, images could be lighter

items.text: Gallery photos are twice the size they are shown at
items.fix: Export gallery photos at the size they are shown

items.text: Files are compressed and cached for 30 days

blocks.name: Labels for search engines
blocks.summary: Title and description are in order

items.text: No note for search engines about the studio's address and hours
items.fix: Add a local-business block with address and opening hours

items.text: Title 46 characters, description 132, one main heading

blocks.name: How fast it opens
blocks.summary: Main content appears in 0.9 seconds on a phone

items.text: Phone 0.9 s, desktop 0.7 s, slow internet 2.1 s
No debug lines, about 6 KB of unused code
First screen 0.4 MB, the whole page 1.1 MB on a phone
